body.en:
Fort building kits have become one of the most dependable repeat sellers in the STEM and family-play sections on Amazon, Walmart, and independent toy sites. From a basic tent frame to a glowing adventure castle, these kits keep selling because they deliver what parents are actually looking for: open-ended play, a little early spatial thinking, and something the whole family can build together, indoors on a rainy weekend or out in the yard.

For brands and cross-border sellers, finding a kit is the easy part. The hard part is finding a factory that gets three details right, because those details decide your returns and your reviews.

  • Connections that are too loose or too tight. If the connector-ball bores and rod diameters aren't held to tight tolerances, builds either wobble apart or fight you at every joint.
  • Rods that can't take a bend. Cheap plastic rods whiten and snap under pressure, which turns into safety concerns and returned boxes.
  • Compliance that drags. CPC/ASTM F963, CE/EN71, and the related physical and chemical rules make export paperwork a long, error-prone process.

Yaoshun Toys (Dongguan Yaoshun Technology Co., Ltd.) is a source factory for plastic toys and precision molds, and we keep the whole chain in-house. That's what lets us offer toy brands, importers, and cross-border sellers a one-stop OEM/ODM program for fort building kits.

From entry gift sets to flagship builds

Our catalog is laid out as a piece-count ladder, so you can match a kit to a market tier and a sales channel, from 69-piece entry sets up to 228-piece flagship kits.

PositionPiece countBest fit
Entry gift sets69 / 72 PCSSocial-media group buys, holiday traffic, fast-moving gift channels
Mainstream bestsellers100 / 120 PCSAmazon and Walmart evergreen SKUs for tent and dome builds
Differentiated lines130 / 168 PCSGlow-in-the-dark and 360° rotating-ball connectors for a higher price point
Flagship228 PCSPreschools, activity channels, and premium family gifting
  • Entry gift sets (69 / 72 PCS): compact, good-value options that work well for social-media group buys and promotional pushes.
  • Mainstream bestsellers (100 / 120 PCS): multicolor rods, connector balls, clips, and a canopy in one box — the steady sellers for e-commerce.
  • Glow and rotating-ball lines (130 / 168 PCS): the glow rods store light and need no power to light up night play, while the 360° rotating connectors free builders from fixed drilling angles, so more complex shapes come together more easily.
  • Flagship (228 PCS Super Magic Edition): four rod lengths for bigger spans and multiple kids building at once, aimed at early-education centers and high-ticket gift retail.

Why buyers choose Yaoshun

We don't assemble kits from parts we source here and there. Material formulation, tooling, injection and extrusion, assembly, and inspection all happen inside our own plant.

  • Tight tooling and a plug feel kids can handle. Our in-house mold shop runs CNC turning, milling, grinding, drilling, and wire cutting, and we hold connector-ball concentricity to micron-level tolerance. A child can push a rod in one-handed, and the frame still stays firm.
  • Rods that bend without snapping. A dedicated extrusion workshop uses flexible, impact-resistant engineering plastic with a toughness-modified formula and continuous cooling and drawing, so rods spring back under bending instead of breaking into sharp edges.
  • Compliance covered. We control raw materials for safety and eco-friendliness across the whole process, and we support CE, CPC, EN71, ASTM F963, RoHS, and REACH testing, plus the export documents and qualification chain that go with them.
  • Fast, flexible delivery. Our technical team returns drawing reviews within 24 hours. Regular bulk orders ship in 7–15 days, and samples and small trial orders let you test the market cheaply and with low risk.

OEM/ODM customization that's hard to copy

If you're chasing differentiation, we offer private molds and full customization across structure, color, and packaging.

  • Structure and accessories: custom connector hole angles, special clips, multi-length rod mixes, or added sound-and-light modules.
  • Color and look: Pantone-matched colors, macaron palettes, retro tones, or a custom glow color.
  • Private-label packaging: multilingual color boxes, Oxford carrying bags, canopy printing, branded instructions, and barcode labels — ready for FBA inbound and retail shelves.

Start with a drawing, a sample, or a brief

Whether you're planning the next seasonal bestseller or looking for steady, high-quality production capacity, we can take you from drawing review and fast sampling all the way to export-ready mass production. Visit www.yaoshuntoys.com, browse the product catalog, or send a brief to info@yaoshuntoys.com.

Factory address: No. 3 Weixing Road, Chashan Town, Dongguan, Guangdong, China.

body.zh:
儿童城堡搭建套件（Fort Building Kit）常见于亚马逊、沃尔玛和品牌独立站的 STEM 与亲子玩具类目。产品从基础帐篷框架到夜光探险主题都有覆盖，玩法开放，适合家庭一起搭建，也便于按价格带规划不同件数。

品牌方和跨境卖家采购城堡搭建套件时，需要重点检查三个细节：连接松紧、杆件韧性和出口资料。

  • 连接松紧不一致。连接球孔径和管材直径的公差没控制好，搭出来的东西要么一碰就散，要么每个接口都费劲。
  • 杆件韧性不足。普通塑料棒一受压力就发白、断裂，带来安全隐患，也带来退货。
  • 出口资料准备。CPC/ASTM F963、CE/EN71 以及相关物理和化学测试资料，需要在项目早期整理。

Yaoshun Toys（东莞市尧顺科技有限公司）是一家做塑料玩具和精密模具的源头工厂，从材料到出货都在自己厂里完成，所以能向全球玩具品牌、进口商和跨境卖家提供一站式的城堡搭建套件 OEM/ODM 服务。

从入门礼品装到旗舰款

我们的产品目录按件数排成阶梯，方便你对应不同的市场档位和销售渠道——从 69 件的入门套装，到 228 件的旗舰款。

定位件数适合场景
入门礼品装69 / 72 件社媒团购、节日促销和礼品渠道
家庭常规款100 / 120 件平台电商常规款，适合帐篷和圆顶屋
差异化功能款130 / 168 件夜光和 360° 旋转球连接件，客单价更高
旗舰款228 件幼儿园、活动渠道和高客单价家庭礼品
  • 入门礼品装（69 / 72 件）：体积小、性价比高，适合社媒团购和节日促销。
  • 家庭常规款（100 / 120 件）：多色拼插棒、连接球、固定夹和顶篷布装在一个盒子里，电商平台的稳定销量款。
  • 夜光和旋转球系列（130 / 168 件）：夜光棒吸光后无需通电就能亮，晚上玩更有氛围；360° 旋转连接件不受固定打孔角度的限制，复杂造型也搭得起来。
  • 旗舰款（228 件超级魔幻版）：四种棒长，跨度更大，适合几个孩子一起搭，主要面向早教机构和高端礼品渠道。

自有模具与生产

材料配方、模具、注塑挤出、组装和检测均在尧顺工厂内完成。

  • 模具精度高，插拔手感适合孩子。厂里的模具车间有数控车、铣、磨、钻和线切割设备，连接球的同心度控制在微米级，孩子一只手就能把棒子插进去，搭好的框架也不会晃。
  • 管子弯而不折。独立的挤管车间用的是柔韧、抗冲击的工程塑料，配合增韧配方和连续冷却牵引，棒子在弯曲时能回弹，不会断成锋利的尖角。
  • 合规资料可配套准备。全程把控原材料的环保和安全，支持 CE、CPC、EN71、ASTM F963、RoHS、REACH 检测，配套的出口文件和资质链条也一并提供。
  • 交期与试单安排。技术团队 24 小时内返回图纸评审意见；常规批量订单 7–15 天出货；也支持打样和小批量试单，便于客户先测试市场。

可定制结构、颜色与包装

项目可按需要调整私模结构、配件、颜色和包装。

  • 结构与配件：定制连接件孔位角度、特殊卡扣、多种棒长组合，或增加声光模块。
  • 颜色与外观：潘通（Pantone）专色、马卡龙色系、复古色系，或定制夜光色。
  • 私标包装：多语言彩盒、牛津布收纳袋、篷布印花、品牌说明书和条码贴标，可按 FBA 入仓和零售货架要求准备。

从一张图纸、一个样品，或一份需求开始

跨境品牌和进口商可从图纸、参考样或需求清单开始，依次推进图纸评审、打样和出口量产。欢迎访问官网 www.yaoshuntoys.com、浏览产品目录，或把需求发到 info@yaoshuntoys.com。

工厂地址：中国广东省东莞市茶山镇伟兴路3号（No. 3 Weixing Road, Chashan Town, Dongguan, Guangdong, China）。
